registration.coordinates: normalized reference-image UV, north at top
registration.note: Oblique illustration traced into plan space. Perspective, hidden slopes and absolute dimensions remain unresolved.

metrics.note: 120 km evaluation domain; substantially enlarged but still compressed. No canonical continental size or elevations are established.

hydrology.note: Vaelorin identity and southward drainage are canon. Digitized courses, channel widths, water levels and catchment boundaries are inferred. Named tributaries are not arbitrarily assigned to visible channels.

climate.note: Latitude is a north–south proxy. Westerly wind, lapse rate, rainfall and soil proxies are model assumptions, not established Vaeloran measurements.
